page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.large is an entry-level compute-optimized virtual server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance configuration provisions 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 4.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

The hardware configuration includes no local storage, requiring the use of external cloud block storage for persistent filesystem needs. No GPU accelerators are present in this profile. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an infrastructure perspective, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides consistent execution without the CPU throttling risks associated with burstable instances. The limited 4.0 GB memory footprint and reliance on network-attached storage represent trade-offs for data-heavy applications. The instance is structured for lightweight compute tasks, containerized microservices, front-end web serving, and small background utility pipelines.
